---
name: Blueprint skill references
description: Use when writing or editing Markdown files in assets/Blueprints.
applyTo: "assets/Blueprints/**/*.md"
---

# Blueprint Skill References

- When referring to a skill, do not link to its `SKILL.md` or another skill file. Name it in inline code followed by the word "skill", as in: Follow the `int-writing-skills` skill.
